dossier.public_summary: The dips do not have a consistent depth: odd and even events differ by a factor of three and lone shallow or absent dips appear, with one sector showing no dip at all. This pattern plus large sector-to-sector changes is typical of a blended eclipsing binary at twice the 14.3-day period, not a 3.3-Earth-radius planet on target.

reasons.why: Odd and even transits have very different depths; positive evidence for an eclipsing binary at twice the period with primary and secondary exchanged.
Individual transits are inconsistent; signal dominated by a couple of deep events, characteristic of systematics or blended binaries rather than a planet.
